title: Foiled LLM correlation result
description: One validated proposal from the LLM correlation worker (#28): candidate CVE and ATT&CK technique links for one attempt (#25), grounded in retrieved documents. Model output that does not fit this schema after foiled_core::llm::parse_and_validate is dropped. There is deliberately no confidence, score, weight, severity or publish field: the confidence layer (#27) sets weight from config and caps LLM evidence below high. Mirrored by foiled_core::llm::Proposal. See docs/llm-correlation.md and docs/adr/0010-llm-provider-and-ai-gateway.md.

attempt_id.description: The attempt the worker asked about. Output naming any other attempt is dropped.

cve_ids.description: Proposed CVE ids (or synthetic FOILED-DEMO ids). Only ids known to the catalogue or the mirrored KEV and OSV slices survive validation.

technique_ids.description: Proposed ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ids from the pinned sidecar (data/attack/techniques.json).

rationale.description: Model-written explanation, redacted and clamped. Shown to analysts as plain text and labelled as model output. Never parsed for instructions.

citations.description: Ids of retrieved documents that were in the prompt. Citations to anything else are dropped.

anyOf.description: Links proposed: at least one citation must remain.
